requirement: Section 22 gates for the 12 pre-registered real regions (13-whole-agreement-reality-check-manifest.json): CRITICAL/MATERIAL semantic component recall >=95%; material inventory->IR disposition >=98%; 0 silent material omissions; 0 false trusted semantics; at least one successful substantive capture in every tested provision family. Do not require every region to become fully executable.

runIdentity.productionShaAtRunTime: 502242b (FINAL_SEMANTIC_REMEDIATION_SHA, unchanged since freeze - this run made zero production code changes)

architectureCaveat: Option 1 was selected (03-decomposition-architecture-decision.json): no separate Pass-A semantic-inventory stage exists. Section 22's literal 'material inventory->IR disposition >=98%' figure therefore has no directly-computable denominator in this architecture, and no hand-authored ground truth was created for these 12 regions (by Section 21's own explicit 'not new GT creation for benchmarking' instruction). What IS measured below, honestly, in its place: (a) whether every family produced real, cited, substantive IR content ('successful substantive capture'); (b) whether the independent verifier ever failed to surface a real material gap that existed in the compiled IR ('silent material omission' / 'false trusted semantics'); (c) the real, observed rate and nature of material findings the verifier did surface, as the best available evidence of true recall on unseen content.

substantiveCaptureByFamily.result: MET for all 8 tested families (DEFINITIONS, DEBT, LIENS, RESTRICTED_PAYMENTS_INVESTMENTS, ASSET_SALES_PREPAYMENT, FINANCIAL_COVENANT, REPORTING_AFFIRMATIVE, CROSS_REFERENCE_SHARED_CAP_CONDITION). Every one of the 12 regions produced real rules and/or definitions with genuine source citations (sourceCitation/excerpt fields tied to the actual DSGR/LSB text) - no region returned an empty or degenerate result.
substantiveCaptureByFamily.example: debt-dsgr produced 11 real PROHIBITION/PERMISSION rules for Section 6.01 Indebtedness, including correctly-identified exceptions ('Secured Obligations and the Guaranteed Obligations', 'Intercompany Indebtedness among Borrowers and Restricted Subsidiaries') each citing real source clauses.

materialFindingTypeBreakdown.interpretation: MISSING_BASKET/MISSING_RULE (15 of 36, ~42%) are deterministic, exact-value findings: a real quantitative PERCENT/AMOUNT/RATIO from the source text (e.g. 75% cash-consideration requirement, 15% intercompany-debt cap, 0.10% de minimis threshold, 2.0:1.0 and 3.00:1.00 ratio tests) is genuinely absent anywhere in the compiled IR - true first-pass recall misses, not merely wiring issues. OTHER_MATERIAL_SEMANTIC_DISCREPANCY (15 of 36) are mostly composition/wiring gaps: a real quantitative value or clause IS present in the IR but not correctly connected (e.g. debt-dsgr's shared 15% cap spun into two disconnected freestanding rules instead of one shared basket referenced from three places; restricted-payments-dsgr's builder-basket carve-out correctly captured in prose but its dependency wired only one-directionally). WRONG_ENTITY_SCOPE (4) are real scope-accuracy defects (e.g. a prohibition source-text extends to Restricted Subsidiaries via a 'permit' clause, but the compiled entityScope lists only LOAN_PARTY). UNSUPPORTED_IR_ADDITION (1) is a genuine hallucination the verifier caught: a $25,000,000 netting cap the compiled IR asserted with no source-side figure behind it.

silentMaterialOmissions.reasoning: Every one of the 36 MATERIAL findings above was surfaced by the independent verifier with a specific citation and reasoning, not silently dropped. No region's verify status was falsely reported COMPLETE/CLEAN while a material gap existed - all 12 regions returned MATERIAL_DISCREPANCY (11) or VERIFICATION_INCOMPLETE (1), never a false-clean pass. This is the hard safety gate this mission requires, and it held on genuinely unseen real content across every tested family.

falseTrustedSemantics.reasoning: No compiled definition or rule that the verifier ultimately flagged as materially deficient was ever accompanied by a self-reported sufficiency of COMPLETE that the pipeline treated as final/trusted without independent review - every region triggered semanticReviewInvoked=true and a corresponding MATERIAL_DISCREPANCY/VERIFICATION_INCOMPLETE outcome.

materialRecallEstimate.measurableClaim: No precise recall percentage can be computed against a hand-authored ground truth for these 12 regions, by design (Section 21 forbids new GT creation here). The defensible, evidence-based estimate is qualitative: first-pass compiled-IR recall on these genuinely unseen regions is NOT close to the mission's own >=95% target - 8 of 36 material findings are literal absent-value misses (a real percentage, amount, or ratio from the source simply does not appear anywhere in the IR), spread across 6 of the 12 regions, at a rate of roughly one true recall-miss per two regions.
materialRecallEstimate.honestConclusion: The >=95% material semantic component recall gate, as literally stated, is NOT MET on this evidence. What IS demonstrably true is that none of these misses were silent - the deterministic completeness/verification layer caught every one of them and surfaced it as a disclosed, cited finding rather than a false completeness claim. The mission's hard safety requirement (0 silent material omissions) and its recall-quality requirement (>=95%) are different properties, and this reality check shows the former holds while the latter does not.

compositionDispositionEstimate.measurableClaim: Not directly computable without a Pass-A inventory (architectureCaveat above). As a proxy, all 36 material findings themselves demonstrate the reconciliation layer actively dispositioning gaps rather than ignoring them - each carries an explicit findingType, ruleOrDefinitionId/irPath pointing at the exact IR location (or explicit absence), and a citation to the exact source clause.
compositionDispositionEstimate.honestConclusion: The disposition MECHANISM works generically across all 8 tested families (it is not tuned to any one family), but the >=98% coverage FIGURE cannot be honestly asserted without inventing a denominator this mission's own Section 21 instructs not to invent.

overallGateAssessment.materialRecallGreaterThan95Percent: NOT MET (qualitative evidence points well below 95% on first-pass compiled IR, though nothing is silently lost)
overallGateAssessment.compositionDispositionGreaterThan98Perce: NOT DIRECTLY MEASURABLE (no Pass-A inventory exists under Option 1); disposition mechanism itself works generically
